III.  All persons engaged in the sale of fish should ensure that they are in good health before working in the
area and that the certification should be in the form specified in the second schedule of this by-law. The
medical examination of a person dealing with food must be conducted from time to time as determined
by the Medical Officers of the area concerned and clinically or epidemiologically.
